To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the main mode of Mediterranean precipitation is related to the dynamics of the North Atlantic storm track and associated moisture transports, and the second mode is the internal redistribution of the moisture inside the Mediterranean, with moisture supplied in the western Mediterranean and transported to the eastern Mediterranean, where it precipitates.

the main mode of precipitation variability in the Mediterranean basin is associated with moisture transports from the North Atlantic, and that the Mediterranean basin is a source region for the eastern Mediterranean.

(i) the first two modes of Mediterranean precipitation are related to the dynamics of the North Atlantic storm track and to the role of the European topography as blocking factor, respectively; and (ii) these two modes of Mediterranean precipi- tation are associated with the same two modes of vertically integrated moisture transport.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of the main modes of moisture transport and precipitation over the Mediterranean region.
a common analysis of monthly precipitation records and the NCEP reanalyses.
the analysis of the main modes of atmospheric moisture transport in the Mediterranean basin and southern Europe, as well as the variability of these modes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the main modes of Mediterranean precipi- tation are related to the main modes of the Mediterranean moisture transport, and the main modes of moisture transport are related to the modes of the atmospheric circulation over Europe and the North Atlantic.

the variability of the Mediterranean precipitation is mainly controlled by the dynamics of the North Atlantic storm track and by the internal dynamics of the Mediterranean basin, and to a lesser degree by the blocking of westerly flows by the European topography.
the Mediterranean region is a very sensitive area to the variability of the large-scale atmospheric dynamics, and the variability of precipitation in the region is strongly linked to this dynamics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the main mode of variability of the Mediterranean precipitation is related to the variability of the North Atlantic storm track.

the main modes of Mediterranean precipitation are related to the main modes of moisture transport, and these modes are mainly controlled by the dynamics and the associated moisture transport of the North Atlantic storm track and its interaction with the European topography.
the Mediterranean precipitation regime is strongly related to the large-scale atmospheric circulation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the NCEP data are able to reproduce the main modes of variability of the Mediterranean precipitation.
a large part of the variability of Mediterranean precipitation is explained by the variability in the dynamics of baroclinicity and moisture transport in the North Atlantic sector.
the Mediterranean region is a sensitive area for the impact of global change.
